sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9689 of 2023

Applicant :- Rajesh Verma Alias Chandrashen
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy.

Home 
Counsel for Applicant :- Shitla Prasad Tripathi,Harish Chandra,Neeraj Tewari,Shiv Lal Ya
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.
It is argued by the counsel for the applicant that the co-accused, father, mother and brother of the applicant have been enlarged on bail vide separate orders.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer but could not dispute the aforesaid fact.

5. Considering the reasoning as recorded in the order dated 03.05.2023 and adopting the same coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 31.12.2022 Rajesh Verma Alias Chandrashen vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32653722/
1 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

entities.text: Rajesh Verma Alias Chandrashen vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Rajesh Verma Alias Chandrashen be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.
185 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Sadulla Nagar,
District Balrampur, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.2.2024 Arun  Rajesh Verma Alias Chandrashen vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32653722/
